summaryZh: Wildonger 实验室研究神经元内部组织和结构如何支持神经通信，尤其是分子马达及微管如何形成轴突和树突区室。团队结合细胞生物学、遗传学和生物化学，使用果蝇模型在活体中操控蛋白活性并成像神经元。
researchQuestions: 分子马达和微管的活动如何形成分别负责发送与接收信号的轴突、树突区室？

evidence.quote: Our goal is to elucidate the mechanisms that govern the internal organization and structure of neurons that is essential to neuronal communication.

We leverage an innovative combination of cell biology, genetics, and biochemistry to elucidate how the activity of molecular motors and microtubules create distinct signal-sending (axon) and signal-receiving (dendrite) compartments. We capitalize on the strengths of a fruit fly model system to precisely manipulate protein activity in vivo and to image neurons live in intact animals.
